recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future content changes to the Quantity translation extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; if the deprecation of the ISO 21090 alias is reconsidered, follow the unresolved FHIR-52952 extension-pack discussion rather than editing core.
issue_request: FHIR-13988 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 MnM change request to define an extension for Quantity translations after the #implementers "Multiple Quantity" discussion. The recorded resolution was "Added as an ISO 21090 extension."
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-13988 was found. Historical core source and R4 history artifacts show the request was applied as the ISO 21090 extension iso21090-PQ-translation, with Quantity context, Quantity value, "Same quantity with different units" text, and a PQ.translation mapping.
additional_context: FHIR-25039 was later Published/Persuasive for R5 and renamed the opaque iso21090-PQ-translation URL to extension-quantity-translation. Core history shows that rename in 2c73520c8c81929f80262da3e04d669c71abcf32 and subsequent removal of extension definitions from the R5 core source in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0. In the current core checkout, the active profile spreadsheets referenced by source/fhir.ini no longer define either quantity translation extension; only source/oids.ini retains the OID assignment for extension-quantity-translation. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout defines active extension-quantity-translation and a retired/deprecated iso21090-PQ-translation that points to the replacement.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no core source change because the current authoritative extension definition is outside the FHIR core checkout.
